definitions.explanation: A sign or status indicating that an area is currently being cleaned.

examples.japanese: ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{清掃中|せいそうちゅう}です。
「{清掃中|せいそうちゅう}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ていた→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: There was a "cleaning in progress" sign out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客室|きゃくしつ}→客室：21608_kyakushitsu⟧{清掃中|せいそうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait while the room is being cleaned.

notes:
{清掃中|せいそうちゅう} is a compound of ⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧ (cleaning) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in progress). It is primarily seen on signs rather than used in conversation.

WHERE YOU'LL SEE IT:
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧: restroom signs
- ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客室|きゃくしつ}→客室：21608_kyakushitsu⟧: hotel room door cards
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}{施設|しせつ}→公共施設：17944_koukyoushisetsu⟧: public buildings, stations

THE 〜{中|ちゅう} PATTERN:
The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ attaches to nouns to mean "in the middle of ~":
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction
- ⟦{点検中|てんけんちゅう}→点検中：10259_tenkenchuu⟧: under inspection
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧: in preparation
- ⟦{使用中|しようちゅう}→使用中：09554_shiyouchuu⟧: in use
- ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧: open for business

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧: cleaning (the action itself)
- ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧: cleaning (more everyday term)
- ⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧ is more formal than ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧ and used for professional or institutional cleaning.
